violations.text: The ceiling tiles in the storage room by the office and bathroom and the front retail area by the cooking products were observed sagging or missing and are in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/24/2026

The wall finishing material was observed detached from the wall in the back storage area by the office and is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/10/2026

The door to the outside, located in the front entry doors and the back receiving door, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 11/21/2024
The receptacle in the women's toilet room is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 10/21/2024
